versions.changelog:
Initial release of system-architecture-builder skill.

- Enables users to design, structure, extend, audit, or standardize system architectures using a layered OS-style model.
- Adapts output depth to the size of the user’s request, from micro OS to enterprise OS.
- Provides detailed guidance on required architecture layers and operational standards.
- Supports artifact generation for workflows, templates, governance, agents, decision-making, integrations, and observability.
- Focuses on creating practical, agent-ready, evidence-aware, and productizable operating systems.
